The '''Lek clan''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] group mentioned in a tale told by Twi'lek [[Parent/Legends|mothers]]. They were rivals with the [[Rha clan]]. [[Ko'lek]] was a notable individual who belonged to the Lek clan.
